label: MqsRAC system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a tripartite MqsRAC toxin-antitoxin-chaperone locus represented by DefenseFinder as a two-profile model requiring MqsRAC__mqsC and MqsRAC__mqsR.
observations: MqsRAC branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual MqsR, MqsA, or MqsC components, the MqsRAC__mqsC and MqsRAC__mqsR HMM profiles, MqsR RNase activity outside a complete antiphage locus, MqsRAC-dependent persister formation, McrBC-assisted T2 inhibition, source database rows naming one MqsRAC model, and other phage-defense systems.
